# `Q-24-2` — Import File Too Large

> The source file is larger than the importer accepts (25 MB). It was refused before the converter was loaded.

## What this means

The file is larger than 25 MB. Importing runs the converter in your browser, and a very large file can exhaust the browser's memory, so larger files are refused up front.

## Why this happens

- The document embeds many or large images, audio or video.

## How to fix

Import a smaller copy: compress the images (in Word, *Picture Format → Compress Pictures*), remove embedded media you don't need, or split the document into parts.
